input.content: Alright, let's clear this up since we're both standing here. I'm Alice - always have been. You keep calling me Clara and insisting you're Alice. Either there's some kind of system glitch, we're in some bizarre parallel dimension situation, or one of us has been seriously misreading their character sheet. Since I can clearly see my name is Alice and always has been, I'm going to assume there's some technical issue on one of our ends. What exactly does your interface show as your character name?
